canonical_statement: For every finite-dimensional smooth compact oriented Riemannian manifold X without boundary, every smooth complex-valued differential k-form omega has a unique orthogonal decomposition omega = h + d alpha + delta beta, where h is harmonic and delta is the metric adjoint of d.

canonical_formal_target.blocker: The pinned environment must supply or define compact oriented Riemannian manifolds, smooth differential forms, the codifferential, the Hodge Laplacian, harmonic forms, and the relevant orthogonal topological direct sums.

domain_and_universes: X is a finite-dimensional smooth compact oriented Riemannian manifold without boundary; k : Nat; forms have Complex coefficients. Lean universes and regularity parameters remain unfrozen pending elaboration.
quantifiers: X : compact oriented Riemannian manifold without boundary
omega : smooth complex-valued k-form on X
hypotheses: X is finite-dimensional, smooth, compact, oriented, Riemannian, and boundaryless
conclusion: There exist unique h, alpha, beta with omega = h + d alpha + delta beta, h harmonic, and the three summands pairwise orthogonal.

alternate_encodings.target: Omega^k(X; C) = Harm^k(X) orthogonal-direct-sum im(d) orthogonal-direct-sum im(delta)
alternate_encodings.relationship: operator/subspace form of the same decomposition

alternate_encodings.target: every complex de Rham cohomology class has a unique harmonic representative
alternate_encodings.relationship: cohomological corollary, not by itself the full form-level decomposition

excluded_degenerate_cases: No degree is excluded. Noncompact manifolds, manifolds with boundary, compact-Kahler bidegree decomposition, algebraic Kahler differentials, and the Hodge conjecture are outside this target.
